verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an MCP gateway / AI control plane, so the axis applies. The pack shows a public GitHub repo (speakeasy-api/gram), but its excerpts only describe features such as usage tracking and RBAC. Nothing documents a self-hosted deployment, install guide, license or on-prem option. Tunneled MCP servers and proxying third-party upstreams are integrations with the hosted platform, not self-hosting the core product.
